question: Do either of the two non-Kindle Duskblade edge-aspect interactions retained by immutable #524 already have sufficient current-main whole-run policy capacity to justify freezing at most one direction for independent confirmation, without retuning the rejected #525 Ward packet?
retrospectiveScope: This is a preregistered zero-new-row necessary-capacity inventory over one complete current-main baseline cache. Immutable #524 supplies only the local causal edge prior. The inventory does not rerun or reconstruct #524/#525, estimate a new causal content effect, admit a package, reopen the exact Ward packet, or support a Scoreline, detector or product claim.

closedDirections.kindleEdgeDisposition: offering->verdantBranch is excluded because immutable #525 exhausted the Kindle/Branch ladder with sufficient held-out precision.
closedDirections.wardBoundary: Only unchanged current-main support for the two immutable level-1 Ward edges may be inventoried. No value, rarity, cost, reward pool, acquisition rule, new card or packet splice may vary.

baseline.name: current-main exact content under the root-551 Ward first-look baseline arm

packageDefinition.name: current-main Ward double
packageDefinition.mediator: Ward gained by the named producer and subsequently doubled by Mirrorlight
packageDefinition.edgeActivation: For a root-551 policy identity, at least one of its four frozen Duskblade Vow-5 simulations ends with the producer and fortify, plays both cards and records positive wardDoubledByFortify.
packageDefinition.reachability: At least one of the four simulations ends with both the named producer and fortify.
packageDefinition.consumerReached: The complete edge-activation witness is present.

cohort.role: Necessary-capacity discovery inventory only; any retained direction requires a disjoint independently preregistered confirmation.

estimands.edgeSupport: For Brace and Bulwark separately, count active, inactive, final-pair reachable, consumer-reached and both-offered policy identities on the same complete current-main rectangle.
estimands.withinFamilySeparation: Count Brace-only, Bulwark-only and cross-active policy identities; descriptive only because both edges belong to one Ward package.
estimands.scorelineSeparation: Count Scoreline-only, Ward-edge-only and cross-active identities for each edge; descriptive only and incapable of admitting a pair when current-main Scoreline has no consumer witness.
estimands.faults: Count Dusk policy rows with a stall/error outcome or non-empty error.

gates.provenance: The 16/16 sensitivity and eight reachability minima are the exact 64-policy first-look gates frozen before the Ward whole-run experiment.

selectionOrderReason: If both unchanged edges clear, Bulwark precedes Brace because immutable #524 measured higher acquisition probability for Bulwark (0.2855902778 versus 0.046875) under the same legacy profile. This order is frozen before reading current-main support counts and is not a numeric retune.

decisionRules.success: At least one unchanged current-main retained Ward edge clears 16 active, 16 inactive, eight reachable and eight consumer-reached policy identities with zero faults. Freeze only the first clear edge in the preregistered order.
decisionRules.futility: Neither unchanged Ward edge clears every necessary-capacity gate, or any fault is present.
decisionRules.inconclusive: Any immutable hash, exact Dusk retained-edge set, #525 closed-family set, current-main content identity, complete policy rectangle, policy identity, ledger identity, numeric input or wall-time assertion fails.
decisionRules.successAuthority: Freeze at most one unchanged current-main Ward edge for a separately preregistered disjoint whole-run capacity confirmation. Do not modify Ward content, claim package admission, rescue Scoreline or spend protected seeds.
decisionRules.futilityAuthority: Close the immutable #524 retained Dusk edge inventory as a source of the missing package and continue to a materially different evidence-backed mechanism inside issue #421. Do not retune or splice the Ward or Kindle families.
decisionRules.inconclusiveAuthority: Record no scientific decision and run no simulator row until the immutable evidence or identity fault is resolved.

methodBoundary: No ML, RL, optimiser, candidate generation, simulation or content construction is authorised. Deterministic code reads only immutable Git blobs and an already complete content-addressed current-main cache.
